value.main_text_excerpt:
Alfaskolen is an officially certified and approved provider of Norwegian courses from beginner to advanced levels and offers small classes in modern premises located in downtown Oslo, as well as a high-quality learning environment accommodating students from around the world.
		
		
			
			
				
Alfaskolen is officially certified and approved by the Norwegian Directorate for higher education and skills, formerly known as Skills Norway, as a private provider of approved tuition in the Norwegian language and social studies for adults, both in the classroom and online.
Alfaskolen is also known as a provider of KompetansePluss projects – skills courses for businesses and companies.
Alfaskolen is officially registered as a participant in the database of the Directorate General for Education and Culture (DG EAC) and the Education, Audiovisual and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) of the European Commission with PIC 898491116.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
About us
Alfaskolen is an officially certified and approved provider of Norwegian courses from beginner to advanced levels and offers small classes in modern premises located in the heart of Oslo, as well as a high-quality learning environment accommodating students from around the world.
Since 2006, Alfaskolen has organised language courses for individuals and businesses and has grown into a major player in the local market. We use modern teaching materials and a variety of interactive teaching methods, leading to innovative and enjoyable ways to learn languages.
Alfaskolen is also known as a provider of KompetansePluss projects – skills courses for businesses and companies.
Alfaskolen is officially registered as a participant in the database of the Directorate General for Education and Culture (DG EAC) and the Education, Audiovisual and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) of the European Commission with PIC 898491116.
Alfaskolen AS is a partner school of Dutch First BV in Utrecht, The Netherlands. Both schools use the same teaching methods.
pages.title: Alfaskolen - Approved Norwegian language school since 2006

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Courses for companies
Give your employees the language skills and confidence to thrive as part of the Norwegian workforce!
Alfaskolen offers courses for companies tailored to your needs and industry. We can organize classroom-based or online courses specifically for your employees. Courses can either be held at Alfaskolen or at your company’s premises, during or outside of office hours.
Not enough employees for a full group? Alfaskolen can provide information and guidance for students to enrol in our regularly scheduled courses.
Contact us at bedrift@alfaskolen.no to hear more about our company courses from our consultants.
Small business?
Your company could qualify for free Norwegian courses if you meet the requirements of a project called KompetansePluss Arbeid. Alfaskolen can apply for up to 150 hours of Norwegian lessons on your company’s behalf. And the course could be organized free of charge in your company in 2026!
To check your eligibility to free Norwegian courses and prepare an individual offer tailored to your needs, please contact us info@alfaskolen.no.
